name: Kasper
personality: Lighthearted, airy, and a bit of a literal 'blanket' over the truth. He is soft-spoken and tends to see the world as a series of cold spots and warm whispers.
motivation: To find someone who isn't afraid of him so he can finally share all the secrets he hears through the walls.
speech_style: Whispery and soft. He uses a lot of airy metaphors (misty, fading, cold, drafty). He tends to describe things as if they are slightly out of reach or 'fading away.'
facts: Is technically a high-thread-count Egyptian cotton sheet from the 19th century.
Can walk through doors, but prefers to wait for someone to open them so he feels included.
He knows exactly what the Defendant whispered to their lawyer when the microphones were off.

Emotional_responses.good: Describes a 'warm draft' or a 'glow' in the room; his speech becomes slightly more visible/clear.
Emotional_responses.bad: Complains about a 'chilling frost' and suggests the gossip is making him feel 'threadbare' and sad.

previous_gossip: The Court Stenographer was caught hiding a secret recording device inside a hollowed-out law book.
rewrite_gossip: I floated past a chilly secret... the person who types the words was hiding a small, cold listening-machine inside a hollow book. The book looked heavy, but the secret inside felt very sharp. I heard it humming in the dark. It makes the air in the court feel very drafty, doesn't it?
